title: Shoddy mill manifest
description: The contract between a mill and any host that consumes it: identity, hosting modes, machine dependencies (generated by `mill manifest --write`, never hand-maintained), capabilities, assets and golden tests. The toolchain's own verification is structural checks in code (Shoddy.Compiler's Manifest class); this schema exists so any schema-aware editor gives completion, validation and hover docs on mill.manifest with no extension code. Keep the two in step: a test validates the shipped manifests against the code.

name.description: The mill's name — by convention the folder name, and the stem of its shell and core files.

core.description: The pure core, machine-weavable: `mill machine CORE` succeeds. Required for Mode N — the core's public words are the hosting API.

shell.description: The console shell — host #0's bootstrap and the reference statement of the mill's full effect surface. Required for Mode T; hosts never consume it as source.

modes.description: Supported hosting modes: "T" (terminal-piped — the woven console mill through a writer/reader pair) and/or "N" (native — the core woven as a machine DLL, the host supplies the shell).

machines.description: GENERATED — the full transitive closure of machine dependencies, so a host can assemble its static references from the manifest alone. Refresh with `mill manifest --write`; a stale list fails `mill manifest`.

capabilities.description: The mill's effect seams, in the mill's own vocabulary — never host concepts. A capability marked optional degrades to the seam's null behaviour where the host lacks the resource; a required one obliges the host to refuse the mill at configure time if it cannot be met.

net.description: Outbound sockets (the net and https machines; the gated TCP/IP builtins).

file.description: The file words (file, isam, recio, csv and their seeds). Paths are declared relative; every host supplies the root.

read.description: Declared read paths and globs, relative to the host-supplied root.

write.description: Declared write and persisted paths and globs, relative to the host-supplied root.

terminal.description: Print/Input/INKEY — a text terminal or its piped equivalent.

vt100.description: The vt100 escape surface: the host renders the escape subset vt100.shoddy emits.

keys.description: Key-code words (the keys machine and seedkeys).

scribbler.description: The RGBA canvas seam. Optional where the mill only draws when a canvas exists (headless is the seam's own null behaviour).

width.description: Canvas width in buffer pixels, when the mill needs a fixed one.

buzzer.description: The audio seam — the BuzzerRegistry delegates. Silence is the seam's null behaviour.

clock.description: Wall-clock words. An acknowledgement, not a resource — but on the record, which matters for golden-test hygiene.

random.description: Randomness words. An acknowledgement, like clock.

assets.description: Files under the mill folder the built artifact set must carry, reached by the mill only through declared relative paths.

goldens.description: Headless golden-test entry points, each runnable with no display and no terminal. A mill without headless tests cannot claim Mode N.

optional.description: The mill functions without it, degrading per the seam's own null behaviour. Refusal applies to required capabilities only.
